slice.en: Here's Greg discussing this point for BBC Radio 4 programme, Sliced Bread: It's interesting, isn't it?
slice.zh: 以下是格雷格为BBC Radio 4节目《Sliced Bread》讨论这一点：“这很有趣，不是吗？”

slice.en: Presenter of BBC Radio 4 programme Sliced Bread, Greg Foot, has lots of emails about the problem.
slice.zh: BBC Radio 4 节目《Sliced Bread》的主持人 Greg Foot 收到了很多关于这个问题的电子邮件。

slice.en: Ultra-processed foods are everywhere, from sliced bread to chocolate biscuits and crisps.
slice.zh: 超加工食品无处不在，从切片面包到巧克力饼干和薯片。

slice.en: And “personal” AI use is just a slice of this.
slice.zh: 而“个人”人工智能的使用只是其中的一小部分。

slice.en: Here he is talking to BBC Radio 4's Sliced Bread.
slice.zh: 这是他在接受 BBC Radio 4 的 Sliced Bread 节目采访。

slowly.en: At the time, information moved slowly and many governments tried to downplay the danger.
slowly.zh: 当时，信息传递缓慢，许多政府试图淡化危险。

slowly.en: If you savour something, you enjoy something as much as possible by experiencing it slowly.
slowly.zh: 如果你“savour”某事，你就会通过缓慢体验来尽情享受它。

slowly.en: Sometimes he would order people slowly tortured, so he could watch their agony.
slowly.zh: 有时他会下令将人慢慢折磨，这样他就能欣赏他们的痛苦。

slowly.en: To savour means to fully enjoy something by experiencing it slowly and mindfully.
slowly.zh: “Savour”的意思是通过缓慢而专注的体验来充分享受某事。

slowly.en: Evolution does not happen overnight. Species change slowly over long periods, across countless generations.
slowly.zh: 进化不是一夜之间发生的。物种在漫长的时间里、历经无数代缓慢地发生着变化。

slope.en: Yes, landslides are where a large amount of earth or rock moves down a slope quickly.
slope.zh: 是的，山体滑坡是指大量泥土或岩石迅速沿斜坡向下移动。

slope.en: And it’s really difficult to become a great snowboarder if there’s no ski slopes for you to practice.
slope.zh: 而且如果没有滑雪场让你练习，要成为一名伟大的单板滑雪运动员也非常困难。

slope.en: And then there is the slippery slope argument.
slope.zh: 此外，还有所谓"滑坡"式的论点。

slope.en: Over thousands of years, Andean civilizations built farms on mountain slopes, developed irrigation systems, and grew crops like potatoes and quinoa.
slope.zh: 在数千年的时间里，安第斯文明在山坡上修建农田，开发灌溉系统，并种植马铃薯和藜麦等作物。

slope.en: That is an advantage. It’s really difficult to become a great skier, an Olympic level skier, if there’s no ski slopes for you to practice.
slope.zh: 这就是优势。如果没有滑雪场让你练习，要成为一名伟大的滑雪运动员——奥运级别的滑雪运动员——是非常困难的。

slightly.en: But find something just slightly above your level, something that forces you to grow.
slightly.zh: 但要找到略高于你水平的东西，能迫使你成长的事物。

slightly.en: The list changed slightly over time, but several monuments regularly appeared in ancient Greek writings.
slightly.zh: 这份名单随着时间推移略有变化，但有几个古迹经常出现在古希腊的著作中。

slightly.en: If you tweak something, you alter it slightly in order to improve it.
slightly.zh: 如果你 tweak（微调）某物，你就会对其进行轻微的改动以便改进它。

slightly.en: They did fall slightly in some areas, and sales slowed down dramatically.
slightly.zh: 它们在某些地区确实略有下跌，销售也急剧放缓。

slightly.en: In the case of one man, his LinkedIn page read slightly differently.
slightly.zh: 但对一个人来说，他的 LinkedIn 页面写得有些与众不同。

slang.en: People also use the slang words, what's-his-name or what's-her-name, for the same reason.
slang.zh: 人们出于同样的原因也会使用俚语“那谁”或“那个女的”。

slang.en: What Silvia really looks forward to is chillin' – a slang word meaning relaxing or hanging out.
slang.zh: Silvia 真正期待的是“chillin'”——这是一个俚语，意思是放松或闲逛。

slang.en: The best way to learn idioms, euphemisms, and slang, is through context.
slang.zh: 学习习语、委婉语和俚语的最佳方式是通过语境。

slang.en: A veggie is slang for a vegetarian, a person who doesn't eat meat.
slang.zh: veggie 是 vegetarian 的俚语，指不吃肉的人。

slang.en: Chillin' is slang for relaxing. And finally, a respite is a break from doing something difficult.
slang.zh: “Chillin'”是表示放松的俚语。最后，“respite”是指从困难的事情中获得休息。

slide.en: Children run barefoot. They swing on ropes and throw themselves down a makeshift water slide.
slide.zh: 孩子们赤脚奔跑。他们在绳索上荡秋千，把自己扔下一个临时的水滑梯。

slide.en: Von Stauffenberg approached the table and slid the briefcase underneath, next to where Hitler was standing.
slide.zh: 冯·施陶芬贝格走近桌子，把公文包塞在桌子下面，挨着希特勒站立的地方。

slide.en: In contrast to pre-made playgrounds, where swings and slides are fixed in place, adventure playgrounds provide pieces of building materials for kids to build things themselves.
slide.zh: 与那些秋千和滑梯固定在原地的预制游乐场相比，冒险游乐场为孩子们提供建筑材料，让他们自己搭建东西。

slide.en: Let's listen now as three BBC journalists from different countries explain to World Service programme, The Fifth Floor, how to say sorry in their culture: I would say that Pakistanis generally – they're not really expressive, and we're also very cheeky so what we generally do is we would slide an apology in the middle of a conversation, and then very quickly move on to a new topic so that we don't have to, sort of, be very upfront about it.
slide.zh: 现在让我们听听来自不同国家的三位BBC记者向世界服务节目《第五层》解释在他们文化中如何道歉：我会说巴基斯坦人通常——他们其实不怎么表现自己，而且我们也挺厚脸皮的，所以我们通常的做法是把道歉塞在谈话中间，然后非常快地转到新话题上，这样我们就不必太直白地去处理它了。

slip.en: The two volunteers would be given slips of paper to decide which one was the "teacher" and which one was the "learner".
slip.zh: 两名志愿者会拿到纸条，用来决定谁是“教师”、谁是“学生”。

slip.en: Nobody seemed to have told the young emperor anything; nobody had slipped over on a stray grape or spilled the wine over someone’s head.
slip.zh: 似乎没人给这位年轻的皇帝讲过什么事；没人踩在落单的葡萄上滑倒，也没人把酒洒在别人的头上。

slip.en: These short tags help express humor or identity, and they usually slip into speech naturally and rarely disrupt the grammar of the main sentence.
slip.zh: 这些简短的标签有助于表达幽默或身份认同，它们通常自然地滑入言语中，极少破坏主句的语法。

slip.en: But he gave Diarmait a letter, essentially a royal permission slip, saying that if any of his English lords wanted to help this exiled Irish king, they were free to do so.
slip.zh: 但他给了 Diarmait 一封信，基本上是一张皇家许可条，声明如果他的任何英国领主想帮助这位流亡的爱尔兰国王，他们可以自由行动。

slight.en: On a slight tangent, this system of patronage is still around today.
slight.zh: 稍微扯远一点，这种赞助制度今天仍然存在。

slight.en: There is, however, a slight problem with it.
slight.zh: 然而，它存在一点小问题。

slight.en: Before we move on to talk more about Easter Island, I think it would be interesting to take a slight detour here.
slight.zh: 在我们继续深入探讨复活节岛之前，我觉得在这里稍微绕个弯会很有趣。

slight.en: Others wanted stability. And many had spent their entire lives preparing for the possibility—just the slightest of possibilities—that they might one day rule.
slight.zh: 其他人则想要稳定。许多人花了一生的大部分时间来为一种可能性做准备——哪怕只是最微小的可能性——那就是他们有朝一日可能会统治国家。

slight.en: Those further away from the Equator had warmer seasons and colder seasons when they got more or less daylight, given the fact that the Earth is on a slight tilt.
slight.zh: 由于地球有轻微的倾斜，离赤道较远的人们在获得或多或少的日光时，会有更温暖和更寒冷的季节。

slap.en: You can throw a baby out of a window. You can fight a crocodile, slapping it with a stick.
slap.zh: 你可以把一个小婴儿扔出窗外。你可以与鳄鱼搏击，用棍子抽打它。

slap.en: A sore head in the morning, perhaps a slap on the wrist from a police officer for doing something more serious, but nothing that will forever change the trajectory of your life.
slap.zh: 顶多是第二天早上头疼，或者因为做了更出格的事挨警察训一顿，但不会有什么能彻底改变你人生轨迹的事。

sleeve.en: And it wasn't just theory, either. As the expression goes, he was more than happy to get his hands dirty, to roll up his sleeves and do the physical work himself, rather than leave it to others.
sleeve.zh: 而且这不仅仅是纸上谈兵。套用一句俗语，他非常乐意弄脏双手，卷起袖子亲自干体力活，而不是把这些留给别人。

slavery.en: Brazil was one of the last countries in the Western Hemisphere to abolish slavery.
slavery.zh: 巴西是西半球最后一个废除奴隶制的国家之一。

slavery.en: And conditions in the Congolese cobalt mines have been likened to modern-day slavery.
slavery.zh: 刚果钴矿里的工作条件甚至被比作现代奴隶制。

slavery.en: Both of these islands have histories that was heavily dominated by the sugar industry and slavery.
slavery.zh: 这两座岛屿的历史都深受糖业和奴隶制的支配。

slavery.en: After disease, slavery and population collapse, the Rapa Nui people were left with little power to resist outside control.
slavery.zh: 在经历疾病、奴隶制和人口崩溃之后，Rapa Nui 人几乎失去了抵抗外部控制的力量。

slavery.en: Black Americans experienced slavery, segregation, and racism.
slavery.zh: 黑人美国人经历过奴隶制、种族隔离和种族主义。

slaughter.en: It was a slaughter. The Romans were soaked, shivering, and unorganised.
slaughter.zh: 这是一场屠杀。罗马人浑身湿透、瑟瑟发抖且毫无阵型。

slaughter.en: There was little advantage to be had in slaughtering your enemy and completely eliminating the threat, as is often the goal in modern combat scenarios.
slaughter.zh: 屠杀敌人并彻底消灭威胁并没有什么太大好处，正如这通常是现代作战场景中的目标一样。

slaughter.en: In his twenties, he worked as a buffalo hunter on the Kansas plains, when the vast herds that had roamed the great plains for centuries were being systematically slaughtered for their hides.
slaughter.zh: 二十多岁时，他在堪萨斯平原上当过猎捕野牛的猎人，当时那些在大平原上漫游了几个世纪的庞大兽群，正被有计划地大批猎杀以获取兽皮。

slave.en: Brazil was the number one recipient of African slaves from the transatlantic slave trade.
slave.zh: 巴西是跨大西洋奴隶贸易中接收非洲奴隶最多的国家。

slave.en: Brazil was the number one recipient of African slaves from the transatlantic slave trade.
slave.zh: 巴西是跨大西洋奴隶贸易中接收非洲奴隶最多的国家。

slave.en: And finally, Tituba, a black slave woman who worked in Reverend Parris’s own home.
slave.zh: 最后是蒂图芭（Tituba），一个在帕里斯牧师家中工作的黑人女奴。

slave.en: These were very valuable things. These plantations relied heavily on African slaves.
slave.zh: 这些是非常有价值的东西。这些种植园严重依赖非洲奴隶。

slave.en: Hundreds of thousands of African slaves lived and worked throughout the country, particularly in the South.
slave.zh: 几十万名非洲奴隶在全国各地生活和工作，特别是在南方。

slippery.en: And then there is the slippery slope argument.
slippery.zh: 此外，还有所谓"滑坡"式的论点。

slack.en: They continued for 8,184 metres before the rope went slack, indicating that the bottom had been hit.
slack.zh: 他们一直下放了8,184米，直到绳子变松，表明已经触底。

slack.en: He created a huge sovereign wealth fund, committing tens of billions of dollars to be invested in technology startups, pouring money into companies like Uber, Slack, WeWork, and DoorDash.
slack.zh: 他成立了一个巨大的主权财富基金，承诺投入数百亿美元投资科技初创公司，向 Uber、Slack、WeWork 和 DoorDash 等公司注入资金。

slack.en: As the men lowered the cannonball, they measured how much rope had been used, with the idea that when the rope went slack, when the line was no longer tight, this meant that the cannonball had hit the bottom.
slack.zh: 当船员们放下炮弹时，他们测量了用去了多少绳子，其原理是当绳子变松、不再紧绷时，这就意味着炮弹已经触底了。

slim.en: Well, most probably not. Software development might not exist in exactly the same way, and the probability of someone typing “create a signup form” into a text interface seems…slim.
slim.zh: 很可能不会了。软件开发到时候的形态，大概率已经和现在不完全一样，到那时还有人在文本界面里敲“帮我做一个注册表单”这种指令的概率……似乎不高。

slim.en: And as for ‘6 7’, well, like anything that starts as an ‘in-joke’, as soon as it enters the mainstream, it ceases to be funny, and stops being used, so the probability of anyone knowing what ‘6 7’ means in even 10 years time seems equally slim.
slim.zh: 至于‘6 7’嘛，就跟任何起源于“圈内梗”的东西一样，一旦进入主流，就不再有趣了，也就不再有人用了，所以哪怕只是十年后，还有人知道‘6 7’是什么意思的概率，似乎同样不高。

sleepy.en: Anghiari is a wonderful Tuscan hill town, but it is a sleepy place: there are more residents who are over the age of 75 than are under 18, and not an awful lot happens there.
sleepy.zh: 安吉亚里是一个迷人的托斯卡纳山城，但它是一个安静的地方：75岁以上的居民比18岁以下的还要多，而且那里发生不了多少大事。

sleepy.en: And in part three, we are going to look at the tragicomic time that two Russian agents travelled to the sleepy town of Salisbury, in England, in a failed attempt to poison a double agent called Sergey Skripal.
sleepy.zh: 在第三部分中，我们将讲述一个悲喜交加的故事：两名俄罗斯特工前往英国平静的索尔兹伯里小镇，试图毒害一名名为谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔（Sergey Skripal）的双重间谍，但最终以失败告终。

slam.en: Luckily, I was a little faster and I managed to slam the door on its nose.'
slam.zh: 幸运的是，我动作快了一点，总算在它鼻子前把门重重地关上了。”

slum.en: Rio’s magnificent European-style boulevards existed next to hillside slums.
slum.zh: 里约宏伟的欧式林荫大道与山坡上的贫民窟并存。

slogan.en: The slogan felt powerful. It promised control and financial security.
slogan.zh: 这个口号听起来很有力量。它承诺了控制权和财务安全。

slogan.en: You’ve probably heard the famous slogan, ‘ No taxation without representation ‘.
slogan.zh: 你可能听过那句著名的口号，“无代表不纳税”。

slogan.en: Different causes, different slogans, but the same structure.
slogan.zh: 不同的诉求，不同的口号，但结构是相同的。

slogan.en: Slogans like, Make Our Country Great Again or Take Back Control, are powerful, not because they’re factual, but because they speak to how people feel.
slogan.zh: 诸如“让我们的国家再次伟大”或“夺回控制权”这样的口号之所以充满力量，不是因为它们符合事实，而是因为它们说中了人们的感受。
